body: Avalon is primarily the king Arthus kingdom raid if there isn't an Avalon event on. Not my favourite raid as you need to avoid the Parry spell. Basically, if you see "waiting", use call of dumbr to prevent your pet from attacking, then turn it off again next turn, which will either be the party strike, or a second waiting for coup de grace
